cited_passage: American Bar Association, Formal Opinion 512, "Generative Artificial Intelligence Tools," July 29, 2024 — used for the ethics analysis tied to Model Rules 1.1, 1.4, 1.6, 3.3, 5.1, and 5.3, including the duty to review AI-assisted work for accuracy and completeness before relying on it. Source: americanbar.org/content/dam/aba/administrative/professional_responsibility/aba-formal-opinion-512.pdf.
